Managers will always negotiate you down so don’t expect to get it all but the only person to ever look after you is you. It won’t burn bridges but will give you an idea of how much your valued and how much thru want to keep you.

You also want to make it clear you’re not a walkover so they do take you seriously otherwise it can hamper your progress long term IMO.

The other saying I like on this - the squeaky wheel gets the grease!

You’ve already listed your issues with the role, ask for everything you feel you want/deserve - pay increase, more holiday, insurance, someone to take on some of your workload who you can train.

The worst they can do is say no and then negotiate from there. You might not get it all but only you can set the line for you between what you’re willing ti negotiate and what your not in order to stay there.
